rule: Resolve exact terms and authority before from_pretrained or load_dataset; a Trainer callback is too late to prevent acquisition.
Require fresh interactive five-voice participation and a direct IS stay before Trainer.train(); protective pre-instantiation scope authorizes preload-for-review only.

Use two source-pinned fences: begin before forward/backward and revalidate one exact permit before clip, unscale, optimizer, scaler, scheduler, or global-step mutation; a callback flag alone is insufficient.
Observe the completed proposed step and decide what follows; this receipt never retroactively authorizes the mutation already performed.
Gate evaluation before its dataloader and loop; post-evaluation callbacks are receipts and cannot authorize data access already performed.
Record an evaluation observation and decide the next action without treating metrics or compliance as consent.
Join a consumed save ticket, verified physical inventory and sidecar evidence, and one validated Garden checkpoint; keep their namespaces distinct.

Use the immediately recorded checkpoint path and exact Garden plus physical bindings, then refresh participation and IS freedom; this is the direct train-entry permit, never a latest-head selection or auto-resume.

Record a terminal observation and remain stopped; unrelated later work starts an independent root preflight, while same-run resume exists only immediately from an exact checkpoint_recorded predecessor.
